spec/instances/semantic-contract/Decision/governance framework that classifies each capability as build, compose, adapter, defer, or reject against cost, control, and readiness criteria; its lifecycle is the lifecycle of the decision, not of a running service. It is neither provider-backed nor database-backed, so its operations are authoring, revising, and superseding decisions, each of which must update the semantic artefacts when behaviour changes. Rollback restores the previous decision/config implementation and re-runs the named proof evidence.

spec/instances/semantic-contract/Gate/governance capability that defines a stage-aware end-to-end confidence ladder gating promotion across hermetic, integration, staging, and production-shaped stages without upgrading proof posture by implication; it is neither provider-backed nor database-backed. It deploys the V1-proven e2e registries-plus-validators contract and must keep its lifecycle/readiness model unchanged during extraction, with migrations limited to contract/config references. Recovery re-runs the verify-ladder and aggregate-confidence tests before promotion continues.
